description: Fetches one time entry from mite by its id; use it when the id is known, otherwise find entries with `mite_list_time_entries`. Returns date, hours, revenue in currency units (null if none), billable and locked flags, customer, project, service, user and note. Fails with "not found" if no time entry has this id.

id.description: Id of the time entry, e.g. 1234567. Required.

name: mite_get_time_entry
title: Get one time entry
